venv\Lib\site-packages\sympy\core\numbers.py:3360:    NaN is mathematically not equal to anything else, even NaN itself.  This
venv\Lib\site-packages\sympy\core\numbers.py:3364:    NaN is not comparable so inequalities raise a TypeError.  This is in
venv\Lib\site-packages\sympy\core\numbers.py:3365:    contrast with floating point nan where all inequalities are false.

venv\Lib\site-packages\torch\distributed\algorithms\ddp_comm_hooks\powerSGD_hook.py:137:    2. ``start_powerSGD_iter`` defers PowerSGD compression until step ``start_powerSGD_iter``, and vanilla allreduce runs prior to step ``start_powerSGD_iter``. This is because that, the beginning of training phase is usually very sensitive to inaccurate gradients, and compressing gradients too early may make the training quickly take a suboptimal trajectory, which can result in an irrecoverable impact on the accuracy.
venv\Lib\site-packages\torch\distributed\algorithms\ddp_comm_hooks\powerSGD_hook.py:139:    To tune ``start_powerSGD_iter``, we suggest to start with 10% of total training steps, and increase it until a satisfactory accuracy is reached.
